record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare BURN_UP: Centiskorch (2 stars) and Sizzlipede (1 star); both maxPP 90, range 1. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage to the cast target (raw 50/100/200/400 by the caster's stars; 50 for 1-star Sizzlipede, 100 for 2-star Centiskorch), then applies BURN to the CASTER ITSELF (not the target) for a requested 3000 ms with the caster as burn origin. The self-burn call comes after the damage call, so the damage is not affected by it. The burn deals 5% of the caster's own max HP per second as TRUE damage unless the caster has Well Baked, a Magmarizer, or immunity/rune protection prevents the burn.

targeting.who: damage: the cast target only; burn: the caster only
targeting.note: No area, no second target. process receives the cast target; pokemon.status.triggerBurn(3000, pokemon, pokemon) passes the caster as both the burned unit and the origin.

geometry.shape: single target damage; self-applied status; no displacement, no area

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage then: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so crit needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT (the last three read in the record BLAZE_KICK that cites the same function).
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The caster's own burn is applied after this call and does not change the damage.

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
statusEffects.resolution: applied to the caster only if it lacks IMMUNITY_BURN, rune protect and the WATER_BUBBLE passive; applied duration = requested after the caster's own duration reductions; replaces the running burn timer (and origin) only if longer than the remaining time, so a longer existing burn is left alone. While burning the caster takes TRUE damage of 5% of its own max HP each second (x1.3 in DROUGHT, x0.7 in RAIN, x0.5 with Assault Vest, reduced by SWIFT_SWIM / HYDRATION / WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER; zero with the WELL_BAKED passive or a Magmarizer). Helper exceptions on the caster: WELL_BAKED gains +20 defense and a MAGMARIZER +30 speed on the first burn only (not if already burning); a Rawst Berry is eaten as soon as the burn is applied. The burn ends when its timer expires (healBurn).

starBehavior.note: Damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (200) and 4-star (400, also the ?? fallback) values are not reachable by the bare factory star counts of these two units. Burn duration does not depend on stars.

record.positionalConditions: None read: the ability needs a target (requiresTarget true) but no cell condition appears in the strategy.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP (90) of PP. A repeat cast while the caster still burns only extends the burn if the new 3000 ms exceeds the remaining time; Well Baked / Magmarizer first-burn bonuses do not repeat while already burning.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 50 (Sizzlipede) / 100 (Centiskorch); burn 3000 ms on the caster. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage and is 0 when the target is protected. Applied burn duration = requested after the caster's reductions, kept only if longer than the running timer; burn tick damage is separate TRUE damage to the caster and 0 for Well Baked / Magmarizer.
